rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The clock is on the CLAIM, not the source's age — durable-account carve-out.
`due:none` scopes the CITATION, not the SOURCE — one URL doing two jobs needs two stamp lines.
Resist prescriptive post-OODA phrasings.
Default to asking before folding findings into strategy docs.
Grep `continuous-research/` and `memory/` before guessing at a name.
Consult research BEFORE generating, not after.
The check RE-FIRES at every nesting level — naming your own claim's population does not discharge it.
A green check must measure the fact, not a proxy that co-varies with it.
A candidate that matches the hunt's SHAPE has not answered the hunt's QUESTION.
Local scheduled tasks catch up on wake, but only once, only for runs missed in last 7 days.
Compendium platform claims rot at 60 days.
Don't extend known mechanism into adjacent context without verifying it fires there.
Fix the contract, not the broken recovery.
Practitioner observation beats docs lookup.
When tool feature behaves differently than expected, update curriculum — not student's workaround.
Auto-load surface = SIX things — four filenames + project `.claude/rules/` + user `~/.claude/rules/`.
Compendium pointers inside files = autoload-redundant.
Transcript-by-mtime selection fragile when current session writes target folder.
PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks read env from harness, not from agent Bash subshells.
Edit-time prompt-edit gate's approval detector MUST parse the transcript deterministically.
Sessions = unit of work — write "start a new session in X," not "open Claude Code in X."
Cross-working-directory boundaries always open `new`; evidence travels by disk.
Same-cwd recovery defaults to `--resume`, not `new`.
CLAUDE.md describes runtime, not just task.
F-Secure curriculum off-limits.
No premature infrastructure.
External org content.
Destructive operations need confirmation.
No "as-is" imports from internet.
Pseudo-URI + kill-switch for public/private content split.
Bulk workbook rebuilds: derive flags from existing output, never guess "all."
Before auditing a built artifact ask whether it ships; before acting on a finding, re-measure it.
Internal audit/session-retro directories default-gitignore from creation.
Canon is declared, not inferred — and an orphan is not automatically spent.
Quality gates run at wind-down, not mid-session.
Tooling test layers carry acceptance-test contract.
Script ratchet — every LLM-orchestration tooling surface ratchets toward script-replaceable assertions.
Hook lints partition into auto-fix vs warn — main thread sees only judgment.
Runner ↔ source pre-flight.
Judge must honor script exit codes.
Eval-fire writing-class fires must schema-validate before presenting verdicts.
Coverage tools enumerate universe, not index of past work.
Cowork sandboxed to its connected working directories.
`maintainer_acceptance` = JSON-level override for accepted/mitigated judge verdicts.
Quality stamps: tooling writes them; the SHA pins committed content.
Cowork capability surface — UI surfaces subagent reads; no session rename in Cowork or Desktop.
Audit scope derives from TRAININGS registry + link-walk, not disk dir or tarball.
Acceptance-test contract covers (i) prompt mechanics + (ii) end-state artefacts, NOT (iii) does prompt's executable shell actually work.
Strategy-doc drift surfaces via judge citation — citation = canary, not verdict.
Portability audits: analyze AGENT'S runtime, not prompt's literal syntax.
Skills at `~/.claude/skills/<name>/` are user-global but per-codebase in content — namespace by SUT.
`state.json` files written by `run-mN.sh` are convenience caches, not authoritative.
`tmux-runner` sessions must use a per-runner socket (`tmux -L runner-$run_id ...`), not the user-wide default.
A killed `run_in_background` Bash wrapper is not evidence the tmux session it launched is dead.
Spend on deleting the duplicate, not on guarding it — and a gate that finds nothing is speculation.
`update-quality.sh` takes ALL classes in ONE invocation per file, and not until that file's last judge has returned.
A hash guard is only as good as what it hashes, and a malformed hash disarms it silently.
Measure the defect before proposing the fix, and again before repeating it to the maintainer.
A judge subagent without evidence is a rubber-stamp, and the summary table cannot tell you which you got.
A gate keyed on the TOOL has a back door; a gate keyed on the FILE does not.
Harness-side caches drift; the artifact is canonical.
Before deleting anything, ask what its FIRING would look like — reference-grep can't tell live from abandoned.
A hook on a gitignored surface is a rule on ONE machine.
`git log -1 --date=short -- <path>` on a DELETED file returns the deletion date.
A detector's reading vocabulary must cover the corpus's writing vocabulary — or it reports compliance as rot.
A verdict has more than one input; a freshness check usually watches one.
"It used to be fast" is a regression report — diagnose it by trajectory, not by architecture.
A bench is silent about everything it cannot stage, and silence reads exactly like a pass.
An instruction whose violation leaves the output identical is not enforced by wording — it needs a measurement or a test.
Forcing functions stay, scripted reactions go. Forcing functions live in prompts, not body prose.
Rule in memory without forcing function = worse than no rule.
Short skeptical pushback on "done" = re-verify trigger.
Verification machinery needs smoke-test before trust.
Context-loading tiers as staged progression.
No placeholders inside fences.
Every prompt block: one-sentence action lead-in.
Canonical shape — lead-in, label with destination, blank line, fence.
Installed Skills invoke by name, never path.
Chain by back-reference + deterministic path, never invented alias.
Chained-prompt isolation — don't leak downstream pipeline.
No session-resets mid-phase.
Multi-sample methods need structural enforcement.
Markdown shout (`**bold**`, `*italic*`) inside fenced prompts = dead weight in Claude Code.
Runtime-fork prompts: paired divs, shared chip.
Runtime-mechanical scaffolding asymmetry — MORE in less-fluent fork, not less.
Append-vs-integrate — name integration mode on regeneration with new context source.
Citation discipline — extend cite-or-flag scope + quote supporting sentence.
Niceness tax — name the edge or pin the line on regeneration.
Question-dump default — `in turn` too soft; two legal shapes.
Overwrite anxiety — name overwrite default on regeneration.
Preamble before action — design around it.
Self-critique register, not defense, when Claude interrogates own work.
Minimal hand-off + Claude self-augments for send-off prompts.
Grill before save — collaborative quality at artefact assembly.
Tell me what you wrote, not show me what you'll write.
Prompt-body edits require maintainer approval — registry files AND inline blocks.
Artifact destinations are explicit subpaths, never naked filenames (Agents 101-specific).
Don't restate session CWD inside prompt body.
`subagent` allowed in prompt blocks; explain why after prompt.
Maintainer-approval edits — ONE-AT-A-TIME, PRIORITY-ORDERED, FOUR-FIELD cards.
Name consumer at write time — `Save it as <path>` requires downstream reader.
Strong-bold prompt label is exactly `**Prompt**` — custom labels break renderer.
Normal work request before orchestration.
Live-test corrections preserve operator workflow.
Prompts live in registry; module/exercise/lecture files reference by marker.
Module names in prompt prose are fine — they ground the session.
Git-output greps asserting exact-N need multi-result fallback.
Disambiguation, anchors, and decision logic that bind Claude live INSIDE prompt fence.
Repeated Q&A → premature re-edits. Separate iteration from persistence.
Wide prompts split by logical move — paragraph breaks = cheapest scan-affordance.
Orient saved rule by where it FIRES, not surface activity producing it.
Body lead-in mirrors prompt's opening phrasing.
Declare `permission-mode:` when paste requires specific Claude Code mode.
Verify session boundary before deciding prompt's context-carrying.
Artifact-vs-STOP tail ordering — last imperative wins.
Headless-runner discipline — tail every prompt with no-AUQ guard.
Long-running prompts stream progress — never go silent.
A leading-looking line can be a forcing function; prefer the simpler prompt.
Prompt paths match Builder scope.
Output shape — trust Claude's defaults, don't pad.
"Add X and regenerate" is a trap.
Vary closings deliberately.
